about_short_description.short_description: Ansible Health is a health care that provides treatments for pulmonary diseases.

product.name: Healthcare Services by Ansible Professionals
product.description: Healthcare services including home-based and telehealth care for patients with pulmonary diseases, provided by affiliated medical groups.

product.name: Pulmonary Rehabilitation Programs
product.description: Programs combining exercise and education to help patients with chronic lung conditions improve physical function and manage symptoms.

product.name: AnsibleChat Peer Support Groups
product.description: Bi-weekly virtual peer support sessions for patients with pulmonary conditions to share experiences and coping strategies.

product.name: Respiratory Therapy Services
product.description: Professional respiratory therapy including diagnostics, rehabilitation, and long-term care support for pulmonary patients.
